parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part of the scissors includes one blade and its corresponding handle, typically made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism, providing one cutting edge and one handle for gripping and applying force.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade and handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting pair, working in conjunction with the first blade handle set to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the central screw or rivet, moving in opposition to the first blade handle set to create the cutting motion.
